correctness.rationale: In angular order m, spherical harmonics degrees <=L reduce exactly to polynomials p(t) degree <=L-m with full/cap Rayleigh norms (1/2)integral t^m(2-t)^m|p|^2 over [0,2]/[0,h]. Positive definiteness is immediate. At fixed n=L-m, the least cap energy is attained asymptotically by rescaled weighted monic minimizer on [0,1], namely shifted Jacobi P_n^(0,m)(2u-1)/binom(2n+m,n). The leading normalization is I_{n,m}=2^{2(n+m)}Beta(2n+m+1,m+1). Competitor gives upper bound; normalize actual minimizers by full norm, bound rescaled coefficients via finite-dimensional norm equivalence, then force lower bound and coefficient convergence by uniqueness of monic orthogonal polynomial. Thus sector floor C_{L,m} h^(2L-m+1), with exact beta/binomial constant; m=0 alone dominates for h->0, and eigenvector uniqueness plus simple Jacobi roots gives eventual zonal simplicity and nodal collapse. Point-evaluation reproducing kernel norm (L+1)^2 gives max eigenvalue ~(L+1)^2h/2 and condition number. L=0 exact h/2.
